edges.target_label: Where Should Knowledge Enter? A Layered Framework for Knowledge Infusion in Multimodal Iterative Generative Models (2026)
edges.note: Where DDPM defined a fixed denoising transition with no place for external constraints, this paper treats that transition and its intermediate states as injection points for knowledge.

edges.target_label: Where Should Knowledge Enter? A Layered Framework for Knowledge Infusion in Multimodal Iterative Generative Models (2026)
edges.note: Where DiT scaled the diffusion backbone without changing how knowledge enters, this paper holds the backbone fixed and varies the infusion layer instead.

edges.target_label: ARM: AutoRegressive Large Multimodal Model with Unified Discrete Representations (2026)
edges.note: Where DALL-E 2 generates images through a separate diffusion path, ARM unifies understanding and generation as one next-token stream over discrete tokens.

edges.target_label: ARM: AutoRegressive Large Multimodal Model with Unified Discrete Representations (2026)
edges.note: Where DiT scales a diffusion backbone with iterative denoising, ARM replaces denoising with autoregressive next-token prediction over a shared discrete latent.

edges.note: ARM reuses the next-token transformer backbone for both image understanding and generation in a single model.

edges.target_label: ARM: AutoRegressive Large Multimodal Model with Unified Discrete Representations (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 used reinforcement-learning post-training for text reasoning, ARM shows the same step transfers to image generation and editing.

edges.target_label: Reasoning for Mobile User Experience with Multimodal LLMs (UXBench, 2026)
edges.note: Where DeepEyesV2 reasons over general images with tools, UXBench fixes the image type to user interfaces and demands a checkable fault diagnosis.

edges.source_label: PyVision: Agentic Vision with Dynamic Tooling (Zhao 2025)
edges.target_label: Reasoning for Mobile User Experience with Multimodal LLMs (UXBench, 2026)
edges.note: Where PyVision applies dynamic tooling to general vision, UXBench constrains the domain so the reasoning is measurable against ground truth.

edges.target_label: Beyond English: Uncovering the Multilingual Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models (2026)
edges.note: Where SigLIP builds a single shared image-text representation space, this paper shows that space is fragile under action fine-tuning, with non-English representations drifting away from the English manifold.

edges.target_label: Beyond English: Uncovering the Multilingual Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models (2026)
edges.note: Where SigLIP 2 adds multilingual pretraining to the encoder, this paper finds a multilingual backbone is not enough: the gap persists after action alignment, which locates the problem in the action head rather than the base model.

edges.target_label: Beyond English: Uncovering the Multilingual Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models (2026)
edges.note: DALL-E 2 is the closest in-library neighbor in the vision-language community; where it builds a shared image-text space for generation, this paper measures how that space degrades for non-English inputs after task-specific alignment.

edges.target_label: Imaginative Perception Tokens Enhance Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models (2026)
edges.note: Where Chain-of-Thought puts the reasoning trace in natural-language steps, IPT moves the trace into a perceptual representation in the visual modality, and reports that for spatial tasks the text trace can lower performance rather than help.

edges.source_label: DiT: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers (Peebles 2023)
edges.target_label: PerceptionDLM: Parallel Region Perception with Multimodal Diffusion Language Models (2026)
edges.note: Where DiT runs a diffusion model on a transformer backbone for image generation, PerceptionDLM carries the diffusion-with-transformer idea onto the language side of a multimodal model and uses parallel decoding to describe several masked regions at once rather than to denoise pixels.

edges.target_label: Perceive-to-Reason: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning (2026)
edges.note: Latent-GRPO is a GRPO variant; PRA-GRPO is a role-aware GRPO variant that alternates perception-focused and reasoning-focused updates so a single reward does not conflate finding the evidence with reasoning over it.

edges.target_label: Perceive-to-Reason: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning (2026)
edges.note: DeepSeek-R1 supplied the reward-based reasoning optimizer (GRPO/RLVR) that P2R builds on, extended here to alternate between perception and reasoning rewards.

edges.target_label: Perceive-to-Reason: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning (2026)
edges.note: The survey maps the multimodal-reasoning landscape; P2R refines it by making the perceive-then-reason split explicit and training it end to end from final-answer reward alone.

edges.target_label: Vision as Unified Multimodal Generation (SenseNova-Vision) (2026)
edges.note: Where DALL-E 2 generated pixels from text for their own sake, SenseNova-Vision reuses the same generative image space to emit dense predictions such as depth and segmentation.

edges.target_label: Vision as Unified Multimodal Generation (SenseNova-Vision) (2026)
edges.note: Where DiT provided a Transformer backbone for diffusion image generation, SenseNova-Vision poses perception as conditional image generation on top of that generative machinery.

edges.target_label: Vision as Unified Multimodal Generation (SenseNova-Vision) (2026)
edges.note: The shared Transformer architecture is the common backbone; SenseNova-Vision converts diverse vision labels into instruction-response pairs and trains one model on all of them.
